headline: VakıfBank Secures $500 Million Climate Financing Package From ADB at COP31
summary: Türkiye's VakıfBank finalized a $500 million credit package with the Asian Development Bank, comprising $400 million in sovereign-guaranteed loans and $100 million in private funding.
why: VakıfBank is one of Turkey's largest state-owned financial institutions.

impacts.name: VakıfBank
impacts.why: Bank secured $500 million in long-term green development financing.
